title: Class: Six Week Pottery Wheel Basics
description: Winona Creators Collective Makerspace. Don’t miss this chance to try your hand at pottery while being taught by a professional: Anne Scott Plummer, WSU Art Professor Emeritus! Buckthorn is a highly invasive species that grows dense thickets that choke out our native forest understories. At William O'Brien, buckthorn is one of our most prolific invasive species and we need your help removing it. Remove buckthorn as long as you'd like, any amount is appreciated. Long sleeves and pants are recommended. Work gloves will be provided or bring your own. Please RSVP if there will be more than 6 in your group. Meet at the visitor center.
